blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Не ___ (понимать), чего вы пристаете… — пожал плечами Митя.
exercises.why: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: «Погляжу издалека… — ___ (думать) он, нерешительно подвигаясь вперед.
exercises.why: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI, Lesson 36. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI,…

exercises.q: «Кажется, никого…» — подумал он, входя в беседку, и тут же ___ (увидеть / видеть) в углу человеческий силуэт…
exercises.why: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).
